doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

title: Early New Orleans trombonists
summary: They run through trombonists of Warner's youth: Zue Robertson, Dutrey, Fields, Gaspard, Baptiste Delisle and Morris French.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I'm wondering about some more of the trombonists when you were young. Did you ever hear Roy Palmer? Do you remember Roy Palmer?
No, I don't remember Roy Palmer.
Played in the district a little.
Who were some of the trombonists when you first started playing that you heard?

I heard, uh, this fella, this young fella, yeah, he was, oh I can't think of that boy's name. He left, yeah, Zoo, Zoo Robertson. I was gonna ask you, just start asking, yeah, Zoo Robertson. Zoo Robertson? Well, he was a good friend of ours, you know. He was a good musician. Mm-hmm. Zoo Robertson, well, and I heard this other boy, this boy. Lord Dutre.
Dutre. He was a good one, too.
And, uh...
George Fields was a good one, too. George Fields. Uh, I must say... Another boy, uh... Ackham used to play, too. Ackham. Ackham. Ackham. I saw his grave.
This other, what you call him, they're this, uh, Vig Gaspar? Oh, yeah, oh, Vig Gaspar. Vig Gaspar. Oh, yeah, yeah. Vig Gaspar. Yeah, yeah. Vig Gaspar. Remember anybody named Baptiste?
Oh, that, that... Baptiste. Baptiste, yeah, yeah, oh, man, that's some kind of... He was here. I don't remember Baptiste. Baptiste still is there?
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Baptiste Delay, yeah. Baptiste Delay, yeah.
Baptiste Delay, yeah. Oh, man.
Baptiste Delay, yeah.
That's right. Baptiste Delay. I think he was the first one to start playing drumming, I think. That's when I heard, huh? Baptiste Delay, yeah.
First one to start playing drumming, I mean, slide. Slide, yeah, slide. That's when I mean, yeah. Yeah, Baptiste Delay. He used to play all his, uh... Yeah, yeah, yeah. All his halls around here.
You're Morris French. Yeah, yeah.
Well, Morris French, yeah, well, Morris French, he come after all those fellas. He's young, so... Yeah, he come after those fellas.
He's good, too.
Yeah, he was all right. Yeah. Yeah, he's good. Dorito. Yeah, Morris French. This boy, uh... But I was telling you about that, it left you and went away.
Drew. Drew Robertson. Drew Robertson. Yeah. You remember him, too, sonny? I played with him, too, in the Allen Band a couple of times.
Yeah. Was he a... Did he play Barrow House, too, or did he just read? Was he?

Yeah. Yeah, he could read and play Barrow House. Mm-hmm. Yeah, he was a long-round man. He played down the district there. Oh, right. He played down the district some time before he left. Then he went away and he came back and he played down that wall and he left and went on off again.
